title: Freeze Sword
description: This is a FABRIC-ONLY (for now) minecraft mod that adds a custom Freeze Sword to the game. Almost every feature is configurable (Fireproof, Allowed enchants, lore and a lot a lot more.)
body:
**It's my first mod ever made, so if you find some errors, I am sorry.**
 
This is a Fabric-only (for now) mod that adds a custom "Freeze Sword" to the game.
I mainly made it for a server with my friends.

Features list:
>  - An icy-styled texture.
>    
>    **and a lot of configurable functions:**
>  - Freeze enemies ability.
     It's cooldown and duration is configurable. (and of course you can turn off this feature if you want)
>  - Custom particles when the ability is used.
>    It's count, speed, offset and even type is configurable.
>  - Custom freezing sound when the ability is used.
>    You can customize it's volume and pitch 
>  - Fireproof (which means that you can configure if the sword should be immune to lava  and fire).
>  - Allowed enchants config.
>  - Custom name and it's gradient animation.
>    You can customize the sword's name and it's animation speed.
>  - Custom lore (description) with three different types of description lines.
>    You can add a standard description line, an empty line or a gradient-styled line!
>  - Enchantment glint without enchants.
>  - Void protection (which means that you can configure if the sword should be immune to dissapearing in void).
>  - Void protection mesasage (which means that you can configure if and what message should players get when their sword gets saved from dissapearing in the void).
>  - Void protection sound (which means that you can configure if a sound should be played when the sword gets saved from dissapearing in the void).
>  - Configurable attack damage and attack speed
>  - Infinite durability config
